quality.rationale: Clean, well-typed TypeScript with sensible data modeling, memoization, and a debounced history-recording effect guarded by a generation ref to avoid stale writes on clear. Accessible roles/aria on the custom dropdown, outside-click and Escape handling. Input sanitization regex is reasonable. Minor nits: history dedup uses exact float equality on input value, and the debounce timer persists conversions somewhat eagerly, but these are small.

uncertainty: Relies on lucide-react and @fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans being among preinstalled packages; if absent, imports would fail (prose claims only preinstalled packages used, not judged).

Build a Pomodoro timer: a 25-minute focus countdown with Start, Pause and Reset buttons, a 5-minute break that starts automatically after each focus session, and a counter of completed focus sessions. Use a clean, centered card layout.

---

How to deliver this:

- You are working in a Next.js 15 (app router) + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 3 project. The project is at `/app`.
- Put the whole UI in the single file `/app/app/sample.tsx`. It does not exist yet: create it from scratch. It must default-export a React component; the home page renders it client-side (start the file with `"use client";`).
- Build that file in steps: first create a short working version (imports, layout, state and the main sections), then extend it with several edits. Keep each write or edit to a few hundred lines: every reply, reasoning included, has an output limit, and a reply cut off at that limit is lost.
- Only `/app/app/sample.tsx` is graded. It is built in a clean copy of this project, so other files you create or change (configs, `package.json`, extra components, `node_modules`) are ignored. Keep everything the UI needs inside this one file.
- There is no internet access: use only what is already installed. Do not run `npm install` or change the project's configuration.
- Check your work before you finish: `cd /app && ./node_modules/.bin/next build` must succeed.
- Do not start long-running servers (`dev`, `preview`, `start`).

Build a pricing page for a note-taking app with three plans (Free, Pro, Team), a monthly/yearly toggle that updates the prices, a highlighted recommended plan, and a short FAQ with expandable answers.

---

How to deliver this:

- You are working in a static web root served by nginx. The project is at `/usr/share/nginx/html`.
- Put the whole UI in the single file `/usr/share/nginx/html/index.html`. It does not exist yet: create it from scratch. It must be one complete, self-contained HTML document (inline CSS and JavaScript; libraries only from public CDNs).
- Build that file in steps: first create a short working version (imports, layout, state and the main sections), then extend it with several edits. Keep each write or edit to a few hundred lines: every reply, reasoning included, has an output limit, and a reply cut off at that limit is lost.
- Only `/usr/share/nginx/html/index.html` is graded. It is built in a clean copy of this project, so other files you create or change (configs, `package.json`, extra components, `node_modules`) are ignored. Keep everything the UI needs inside this one file.
- There is no internet access: use only what is already installed. Do not run `npm install` or change the project's configuration.
- Check your work before you finish: the file must be a complete HTML document (`<!doctype html>` or `<html>`, and `</html>`).
- Do not start long-running servers (`dev`, `preview`, `start`).

input.content:
Build a one-page landing site for a fictional neighborhood coffee shop called "Bean There": a hero section with a headline and a call-to-action button, a menu grid with six drinks and prices, opening hours, and a contact form with name, email and message fields.

---

How to deliver this:

- You are working in a static web root served by nginx. The project is at `/usr/share/nginx/html`.
- Put the whole UI in the single file `/usr/share/nginx/html/index.html`. It does not exist yet: create it from scratch. It must be one complete, self-contained HTML document (inline CSS and JavaScript; libraries only from public CDNs).

<script>
  (function () {
    'use strict';

    /* ----- header + mobile nav ----- */
    var header = document.getElementById('siteHeader');
    var toggle = document.getElementById('navToggle');
    var nav = document.getElementById('siteNav');

    var onScroll = function () {
      header.classList.toggle('is-scrolled', window.scrollY > 8);
    };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();

    var setNav = function (open) {
      nav.classList.toggle('is-open', open);
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu');
    };
    toggle.addEventListener('click', function () {
      setNav(!nav.classList.contains('is-open'));
    });
    nav.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      if (event.target.closest('a')) setNav(false);
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
      if (event.key === 'Escape' && nav.classList.contains('is-open')) {
        setNav(false);
        toggle.focus();
      }
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      if (!nav.contains(event.target) && !toggle.contains(event.target)) setNav(false);
    });
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
      if (window.innerWidth > 820) setNav(false);
    });

    /* ----- menu filter ----- */
    var filters = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.filter'));
    var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item'));
    var count = document.getElementById('menuCount');
    var labels = {
      all: 'Showing all 6 drinks',
      espresso: 'Showing 2 espresso drinks',
      brewed: 'Showing 2 brewed drinks',
      cold: 'Showing 2 cold drinks'
    };

    var applyFilter = function (value) {
      items.forEach(function (item) {
        item.classList.toggle('is-hidden', value !== 'all' && item.dataset.cat !== value);
      });
      filters.forEach(function (button) {
        var active = button.dataset.filter === value;
        button.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
        button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
      });
      count.textContent = labels[value] || labels.all;
    };

    filters.forEach(function (button) {
      button.addEventListener('click', function () {
        applyFilter(button.dataset.filter);
      });
    });
    applyFilter('all');

    /* ----- hours ----- */
    var SCHEDULE = {
      0: { open: 8 * 60, close: 15 * 60 },
      1: { open: 7 * 60, close: 18 * 60 },
      2: { open: 7 * 60, close: 18 * 60 },
      3: { open: 7 * 60, close: 18 * 60 },
      4: { open: 7 * 60, close: 18 * 60 },
      5: { open: 7 * 60, close: 18 * 60 },
      6: { open: 8 * 60, close: 18 * 60 }
    };
    var DAY_NAMES = ['Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday'];

    var fmt = function (minutes) {
      var hour = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
      var minute = minutes % 60;
      var suffix = hour >= 12 ? 'pm' : 'am';
      var display = hour % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hour % 12;
      return display + ':' + (minute < 10 ? '0' + minute : minute) + ' ' + suffix;
    };

    var heroStatus = document.getElementById('heroStatus');
    var heroDot = document.getElementById('heroStatusDot');
    var hoursStatus = document.getElementById('hoursStatus');
    var hoursDot = document.getElementById('hoursStatusDot');
    var openPill = document.getElementById('openPill');
    var openPillText = document.getElementById('openPillText');

    var updateHours = function () {
      var now = new Date();
      var day = now.getDay();
      var minutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
      var today = SCHEDULE[day];
      var isOpen = minutes >= today.open && minutes < today.close;
      var message = '';
      var shortMessage = '';

      if (isOpen) {
        shortMessage = 'Open today until ' + fmt(today.close);
        message = 'Open now — we are pouring until ' + fmt(today.close) + '.';
      } else if (minutes < today.open) {
        shortMessage = 'Opens today at ' + fmt(today.open);
        message = 'Closed now — the door opens today at ' + fmt(today.open) + '.';
      } else {
        var nextDay = day;
        var offset = 1;
        while (offset <= 7) {
          nextDay = (day + offset) % 7;
          if (SCHEDULE[nextDay]) break;
          offset += 1;
        }
        var when = offset === 1 ? 'tomorrow' : 'on ' + DAY_NAMES[nextDay];
        shortMessage = 'Closed — opens ' + when + ' at ' + fmt(SCHEDULE[nextDay].open);
        message = 'Closed now — back ' + when + ' at ' + fmt(SCHEDULE[nextDay].open) + '.';
      }

      heroStatus.textContent = shortMessage;
      hoursStatus.textContent = message;
      heroDot.classList.toggle('is-closed', !isOpen);
      hoursDot.classList.toggle('is-closed', !isOpen);
      openPill.classList.toggle('is-closed', !isOpen);
      openPillText.textContent = isOpen ? 'Open now' : 'Closed';

      Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.hours-list li'), function (row) {
        var days = (row.dataset.days || '').split(',').map(Number);
        row.classList.toggle('is-today', days.indexOf(day) !== -1);
      });
    };
    updateHours();
    window.setInterval(updateHours, 60000);

    /* ----- reveal on scroll ----- */
    var revealItems = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.reveal'));
    items.forEach(function (item, index) {
      item.style.transitionDelay = Math.min(index * 55, 330) + 'ms';
    });

    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('is-in');
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });
      revealItems.forEach(function (item) { observer.observe(item); });
    } else {
      revealItems.forEach(function (item) { item.classList.add('is-in'); });
    }

    /* ----- contact form ----- */
    var form = document.getElementById('contactForm');
    var success = document.getElementById('formSuccess');
    var successName = document.getElementById('successName');
    var submit = form.querySelector('.form-submit');
    var fields = {
      name: document.getElementById('name'),
      email: document.getElementById('email'),
      message: document.getElementById('message')
    };
    var emailPattern = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/;

    var setError = function (key, hasError, text) {
      var input = fields[key];
      var error = document.getElementById(key + 'Error');
      var wrap = input.closest('.field');
      wrap.classList.toggle('has-error', hasError);
      input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', hasError ? 'true' : 'false');
      if (hasError && text) error.textContent = text;
      error.hidden = !hasError;
    };

    var checks = {
      name: function () {
        if (fields.name.value.trim().length < 2) {
          setError('name', true, 'Please tell us what to call you.');
          return false;
        }
        setError('name', false);
        return true;
      },
      email: function () {
        if (!emailPattern.test(fields.email.value.trim())) {
          setError('email', true, 'That email does not look quite right.');
          return false;
        }
        setError('email', false);
        return true;
      },
      message: function () {
        if (fields.message.value.trim().length < 5) {
          setError('message', true, 'A few words are all we need.');
          return false;
        }
        setError('message', false);
        return true;
      }
    };

    Object.keys(fields).forEach(function (key) {
      fields[key].addEventListener('input', function () {
        if (fields[key].closest('.field').classList.contains('has-error')) checks[key]();
      });
    });

    form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      var valid = ['name', 'email', 'message'].map(function (key) { return checks[key](); }).every(Boolean);

      if (!valid) {
        var firstError = form.querySelector('.field.has-error input, .field.has-error textarea');
        if (firstError) firstError.focus();
        return;
      }

      var firstName = fields.name.value.trim().split(/\s+/)[0];
      var original = submit.innerHTML;
      success.hidden = true;
      submit.disabled = true;
      submit.textContent = 'Sending…';

      window.setTimeout(function () {
        submit.disabled = false;
        submit.innerHTML = original;
        successName.textContent = firstName;
        success.hidden = false;
        form.reset();
        submit.focus();
      }, 650);
    });

    form.addEventListener('reset', function () {
      window.setTimeout(function () {
        Object.keys(fields).forEach(function (key) {
          fields[key].setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
          fields[key].closest('.field').classList.remove('has-error');
          document.getElementById(key + 'Error').hidden = true;
        });
      }, 0);
    });

    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
  })();
</script>

  body::after{

  .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}

  /* ---------- menu ---------- */
  .menu-section{
    position:relative;padding:clamp(4rem,8vw,7rem) 0;

  .menu-grid{
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
    column-gap:clamp(1.8rem,3.2vw,3rem);row-gap:2.1rem;
  }
  .menu-item{padding-bottom:1.75rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .menu-item.is-hidden{display:none}
  .menu-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:.55rem}
  .menu-head h3{
    font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.32rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.25;
    transition:color .2s ease;
  }
  .menu-item:hover .menu-head h3{color:var(--caramel)}
  .leader{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:18px;border-bottom:1px dotted rgba(42,32,26,.32);transform:translateY(-5px)}
  .price{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.08rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
  .menu-item p{font-size:.87rem;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.62;margin-top:.5rem;max-width:34ch}
  .menu-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.35rem;margin-top:.95rem}
  .menu-tags span{
    font-size:.63rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--ink-soft);background:rgba(42,32,26,.055);border-radius:999px;padding:.3rem .6rem;
  }
  .menu-tags .tag-fav{background:var(--caramel-soft);color:#7c4a20}
  .menu-note{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;margin-top:2.6rem;
    font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .menu-note svg{width:17px;height:17px;flex:none;color:var(--caramel)}

  /* ---------- hours ---------- */
  .hours-section{
    position:relative;overflow:hidden;color:#f4ede0;
    padding:clamp(4rem,8vw,7rem) 0;
    background:radial-gradient(circle at 88% 8%,#3d5745 0%,#2c3f31 46%,#24342a 100%);
  }
  .hours-section::before{
    content:"";position:absolute;left:-180px;bottom:-220px;width:520px;height:520px;
    border:1px solid rgba(244,237,224,.09);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;
  }
  .hours-section::after{
    content:"";position:absolute;right:-60px;top:-120px;width:280px;height:280px;
    border:1px dashed rgba(244,237,224,.08);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;
  }
  .hours-grid{
    position:relative;z-index:1;
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:clamp(2.5rem,5vw,5rem);align-items:center;
  }
  .eyebrow-light{color:rgba(247,241,231,.62)}
  .eyebrow-light::before{background:var(--caramel-soft)}
  .hours-title{color:#f7f1e7;margin-block:.9rem 1.35rem;font-size:clamp(2.2rem,4.2vw,3.3rem)}
  .hours-title em{color:#e3bd8d}
  .hours-lead{color:rgba(247,241,231,.72);max-width:42ch;font-size:.94rem;margin-bottom:2.1rem}
  .hours-facts{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:.95rem;font-size:.85rem;color:rgba(247,241,231,.86)}
  .hours-facts li{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:.75rem;line-height:1.55}
  .hours-facts svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none;color:#e3bd8d;margin-top:.18rem}
  .hours-facts a{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(227,189,141,.4);transition:color .2s ease,border-color .2s ease}
  .hours-facts a:hover{color:#e3bd8d;border-color:#e3bd8d}
  .hours-live{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;margin-top:2.2rem;
    padding:.6rem 1rem;border:1px solid rgba(247,241,231,.18);border-radius:999px;

  .hours-card{
    background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);border-radius:24px;

  }
  .hours-card-head{
    display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;
    padding-bottom:1.25rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .hours-kicker{font-size:.64rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:.4rem}
  .hours-card-head h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.48rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.2}
  .open-pill{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.42rem;flex:none;
    font-size:.64rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;

  }
  .open-pill i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#4d7c57}
  .open-pill.is-closed{background:rgba(164,85,61,.13);color:#8d4632}
  .open-pill.is-closed i{background:#a4553d}
  .hours-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:.35rem 0 0}
  .hours-list li{
    display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:.6rem;padding:.82rem .35rem;

  .hours-rule{flex:1;border-bottom:1px dotted rgba(42,32,26,.3);transform:translateY(-4px)}
  .hours-time{color:var(--ink-soft);white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:.84rem}

  .hours-foot{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:.55rem;margin-top:1.25rem;font-size:.73rem;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .hours-foot svg{width:15px;height:15px;flex:none;margin-top:.1rem;color:var(--caramel)}

  /* ---------- contact ---------- */
  .contact-section{padding:clamp(4rem,8vw,7rem) 0;position:relative}
  .contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.92fr 1.08fr;gap:clamp(2.5rem,5vw,5rem);align-items:start}
  .contact-copy{padding-top:.4rem}
  .contact-copy h2{
    font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(2.1rem,4vw,3.35rem);
    letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:1.03;margin:.9rem 0 1.25rem;
  }
  .contact-copy h2 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--caramel);font-weight:400}
  .contact-lead{color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:40ch;font-size:.94rem;margin-bottom:2.1rem}

  .field label{display:block;font-size:.63rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:.42rem}

    display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:.55rem;padding:.8rem .95rem;border-radius:12px;

  }
  .form-success svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none;margin-top:.05rem}
  [hidden]{display:none !important}

  /* ---------- footer ---------- */
  .site-footer{background:#221a15;color:#f4ede0;padding:clamp(2.8rem,5vw,3.8rem) 0 2.2rem}
  .footer-inner{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr auto;gap:1.6rem 3rem;align-items:start}
  .footer-name{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.65rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.02em}

    grid-column:1/-1;margin-top:1.2rem;padding-top:1.4rem;
    border-top:1px solid rgba(244,237,224,.12);
    font-size:.7rem;color:rgba(244,237,224,.52);line-height:1.6;
  }

  /* ---------- responsive ---------- */
  section[id],main[id]{scroll-margin-top:92px}
  @media (max-width:1020px){

    .site-nav a{padding:.8rem 0;font-size:1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
    .site-nav a::after{display:none}
    .site-nav a.nav-cta{margin-top:1rem;border-bottom:0;justify-content:center;padding:.85rem 1.25rem;color:var(--cream);font-size:.95rem}
    .chip-rating{right:0}
    .chip-roast{left:0}

  }
  @media (max-width:620px){
    .wrap{padding-inline:20px}
    .hero{padding-top:2.2rem}
    .hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,10vw,3.1rem)}
    .hero-actions{width:100%}

    .hero-meta{gap:.5rem 1rem;font-size:.8rem}
    .hero-meta .dot{display:none}
    .hero-art{max-width:350px;margin-inline:auto}
    .float-chip{padding:.55rem .7rem;font-size:.71rem}
    .float-chip small{font-size:.64rem}
    .chip-icon{width:28px;height:28px;font-size:.78rem}

    .chip-roast{bottom:7%;left:-2%}
    .stamp{width:78px;height:78px;font-size:.48rem;right:-1%;bottom:-2%}

    .hours-card-head{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:.8rem}
    .hours-live{align-items:flex-start;font-size:.7rem}
    .contact-details > div{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:.1rem}
    .footer-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:1.2rem}
    .footer-copy{grid-column:auto}
    .field input,.field textarea{font-size:16px}
    .form-card{padding:1.4rem 1.2rem}
  }
</style>

<script>
  (function () {
    'use strict';

    /* ----- header + mobile nav ----- */
    var header = document.getElementById('siteHeader');
    var toggle = document.getElementById('navToggle');
    var nav = document.getElementById('siteNav');

    var onScroll = function () {
      header.classList.toggle('is-scrolled', window.scrollY > 8);
    };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();

    var setNav = function (open) {
      nav.classList.toggle('is-open', open);
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu');
    };
    toggle.addEventListener('click', function () {
      setNav(!nav.classList.contains('is-open'));
    });
    nav.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      if (event.target.closest('a')) setNav(false);
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
      if (event.key === 'Escape' && nav.classList.contains('is-open')) {
        setNav(false);
        toggle.focus();
      }
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      if (!nav.contains(event.target) && !toggle.contains(event.target)) setNav(false);
    });
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
      if (window.innerWidth > 820) setNav(false);
    });

    /* ----- menu filter ----- */
    var filters = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.filter'));
    var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item'));
    var count = document.getElementById('menuCount');
    var labels = {
      all: 'Showing all 6 drinks',
      espresso: 'Showing 2 espresso drinks',
      brewed: 'Showing 2 brewed drinks',
      cold: 'Showing 2 cold drinks'
    };

    var applyFilter = function (value) {
      items.forEach(function (item) {
        item.classList.toggle('is-hidden', value !== 'all' && item.dataset.cat !== value);
      });
      filters.forEach(function (button) {
        var active = button.dataset.filter === value;
        button.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
        button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
      });
      count.textContent = labels[value] || labels.all;
    };

    filters.forEach(function (button) {
      button.addEventListener('click', function () {
        applyFilter(button.dataset.filter);
      });
    });
    applyFilter('all');

    /* ----- hours ----- */
    var SCHEDULE = {
      0: { open: 8 * 60, close: 15 * 60 },
      1: { open: 7 * 60, close: 18 * 60 },
      2: { open: 7 * 60, close: 18 * 60 },
      3: { open: 7 * 60, close: 18 * 60 },
      4: { open: 7 * 60, close: 18 * 60 },
      5: { open: 7 * 60, close: 18 * 60 },
      6: { open: 8 * 60, close: 18 * 60 }
    };
    var DAY_NAMES = ['Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday'];

    var fmt = function (minutes) {
      var hour = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
      var minute = minutes % 60;
      var suffix = hour >= 12 ? 'pm' : 'am';
      var display = hour % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hour % 12;
      return display + ':' + (minute < 10 ? '0' + minute : minute) + ' ' + suffix;
    };

    var heroStatus = document.getElementById('heroStatus');
    var heroDot = document.getElementById('heroStatusDot');
    var hoursStatus = document.getElementById('hoursStatus');
    var hoursDot = document.getElementById('hoursStatusDot');
    var openPill = document.getElementById('openPill');
    var openPillText = document.getElementById('openPillText');

    var updateHours = function () {
      var now = new Date();
      var day = now.getDay();
      var minutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
      var today = SCHEDULE[day];
      var isOpen = minutes >= today.open && minutes < today.close;
      var message = '';
      var shortMessage = '';

      if (isOpen) {
        shortMessage = 'Open today until ' + fmt(today.close);
        message = 'Open now — we are pouring until ' + fmt(today.close) + '.';
      } else if (minutes < today.open) {
        shortMessage = 'Opens today at ' + fmt(today.open);
        message = 'Closed now — the door opens today at ' + fmt(today.open) + '.';
      } else {
        var nextDay = day;
        var offset = 1;
        while (offset <= 7) {
          nextDay = (day + offset) % 7;
          if (SCHEDULE[nextDay]) break;
          offset += 1;
        }
        var when = offset === 1 ? 'tomorrow' : 'on ' + DAY_NAMES[nextDay];
        shortMessage = 'Closed — opens ' + when + ' at ' + fmt(SCHEDULE[nextDay].open);
        message = 'Closed now — back ' + when + ' at ' + fmt(SCHEDULE[nextDay].open) + '.';
      }

      heroStatus.textContent = shortMessage;
      hoursStatus.textContent = message;
      heroDot.classList.toggle('is-closed', !isOpen);
      hoursDot.classList.toggle('is-closed', !isOpen);
      openPill.classList.toggle('is-closed', !isOpen);
      openPillText.textContent = isOpen ? 'Open now' : 'Closed';

      Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.hours-list li'), function (row) {
        var days = (row.dataset.days || '').split(',').map(Number);
        row.classList.toggle('is-today', days.indexOf(day) !== -1);
      });
    };
    updateHours();
    window.setInterval(updateHours, 60000);

    /* ----- reveal on scroll ----- */
    var revealItems = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.reveal'));
    items.forEach(function (item, index) {
      item.style.transitionDelay = Math.min(index * 55, 330) + 'ms';
    });

    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('is-in');
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });
      revealItems.forEach(function (item) { observer.observe(item); });
    } else {
      revealItems.forEach(function (item) { item.classList.add('is-in'); });
    }

    /* ----- contact form ----- */
    var form = document.getElementById('contactForm');
    var success = document.getElementById('formSuccess');
    var successName = document.getElementById('successName');
    var submit = form.querySelector('.form-submit');
    var fields = {
      name: document.getElementById('name'),
      email: document.getElementById('email'),
      message: document.getElementById('message')
    };
    var emailPattern = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/;

    var setError = function (key, hasError, text) {
      var input = fields[key];
      var error = document.getElementById(key + 'Error');
      var wrap = input.closest('.field');
      wrap.classList.toggle('has-error', hasError);
      input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', hasError ? 'true' : 'false');
      if (hasError && text) error.textContent = text;
      error.hidden = !hasError;
    };

    var checks = {
      name: function () {
        if (fields.name.value.trim().length < 2) {
          setError('name', true, 'Please tell us what to call you.');
          return false;
        }
        setError('name', false);
        return true;
      },
      email: function () {
        if (!emailPattern.test(fields.email.value.trim())) {
          setError('email', true, 'That email does not look quite right.');
          return false;
        }
        setError('email', false);
        return true;
      },
      message: function () {
        if (fields.message.value.trim().length < 5) {
          setError('message', true, 'A few words are all we need.');
          return false;
        }
        setError('message', false);
        return true;
      }
    };

    Object.keys(fields).forEach(function (key) {
      fields[key].addEventListener('input', function () {
        if (fields[key].closest('.field').classList.contains('has-error')) checks[key]();
      });
    });

    form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      var valid = ['name', 'email', 'message'].map(function (key) { return checks[key](); }).every(Boolean);

      if (!valid) {
        var firstError = form.querySelector('.field.has-error input, .field.has-error textarea');
        if (firstError) firstError.focus();
        return;
      }

      var firstName = fields.name.value.trim().split(/\s+/)[0];
      var original = submit.innerHTML;
      success.hidden = true;
      submit.disabled = true;
      submit.textContent = 'Sending…';

      window.setTimeout(function () {
        submit.disabled = false;
        submit.innerHTML = original;
        successName.textContent = firstName;
        success.hidden = false;
        form.reset();
        submit.focus();
      }, 650);
    });

    form.addEventListener('reset', function () {
      window.setTimeout(function () {
        Object.keys(fields).forEach(function (key) {
          fields[key].setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
          fields[key].closest('.field').classList.remove('has-error');
          document.getElementById(key + 'Error').hidden = true;
        });
      }, 0);
    });

    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>

prompt_adherence.rationale: Every requested element is present and well-realized: hero with headline ('Good coffee, better neighbors.') and CTA button ('Explore the menu'), a menu grid with exactly six drinks each with a price, opening hours section (seven days), and a contact form with name, email and message fields. It is a single self-contained static HTML file with inline CSS/JS and only CDN-hosted Google Fonts, matching the stack. Extras (filters, live-open status, validation) go beyond but do not conflict with requirements.

quality.rationale: Clean IIFE-scoped JS with 'use strict', graceful IntersectionObserver fallback, prefers-reduced-motion handling, accessible markup (skip link, aria-labelledby, aria-live, aria-expanded, focus management, aria-invalid), responsive breakpoints, and solid form validation. IDs referenced in JS all exist in markup. Minor nits: menu count labels are hardcoded rather than computed, and the submit button reset uses innerHTML restore after a textContent swap which works but is slightly fragile. Overall professional and coherent.

uncertainty: Cannot verify runtime rendering, font CDN loading, or animation behavior without execution; assessed from code reading only.
